static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.social_status: Avoiding socializing and job interviews, lacking support from friends and family with whom to discuss insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: Insecurity related to height has existed since adolescence; has not yet received psychological counseling or psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense (self-reported nervousness); clear expression, able to self-reflect; fairly cooperative, willing to try journaling and positive self-talk

basic_info.main_problem: Long-term insecurity about one's height, believing one will always be judged by others because of height and thus never get opportunities; especially prominent in job interviews and social situations, leading to avoidance and impaired self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to gain psychological support, reduce height-induced insecurity and fear of being evaluated, and improve confidence and performance in job interviews.
growth_experiences: Mocked and ignored by peers at school during adolescence because of height, forming self-insecurity that has persisted to this day; in adulthood continuously triggering that insecurity in interview and social situations, leading to avoidance behaviors and affected self-esteem; never sought psychological counseling or treatment before.

core_beliefs: My height determines others' evaluation of me and my opportunities
No matter what I do, it is not good enough (height will make others negate me)

special_situations.event: Entering or about to enter a job interview
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the interviewer sees my height at first glance, they will deem me unsuitable and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding interviews or attending in a tense, self-doubting state; trying to briefly boost confidence with positive self-talk but hard to sustain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will negate me at first glance; no matter how I prepare I will be rejected

special_situations.event: In the interview preparation stage or on site when needing to emphasize qualifications and abilities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as my height is not an advantage, no matter how well I perform it will be of no avail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Difficulty focusing on showcasing qualifications and abilities, falling into self-doubt; using self-denial to undo anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do it is not good enough

special_situations.event: When attending social or workplace networking events and first making contact with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others will directly link my height with ability, thinking I am not professional
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces participation in social and online activities to avoid being judged; gains comfort from being with the dog
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am not professional enough and no good

special_situations.event: When the not-yet-hired result after the interview appears or is recalled
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I did not get the job, it must be because of my height
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Singularly attributing failure to height, ignoring other possible interpretations, thus intensifying avoidance and self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not getting the job was caused by my height

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be fairly evaluated and accepted and to gain opportunities through ability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being humiliated and rejected because of height, worrying self-worth will be negated
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged and protecting self-esteem by avoiding socializing and interviews

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable job seeker who is judged and easily negated

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires about the reasons for not yet being hired or invites considering other possible interpretations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to understand hiring decisions as negation of one's height (seeing others' decisions as judgments targeting one's physical features)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a rather firm tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'it is mainly because of height', downplaying other factors; using absolutist expressions, giving few concrete examples.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor focuses on the feelings in social situations and others' views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will look down on oneself and find one unprofessional (attributing inner insecurity to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describing others' thoughts in certain language, e.g. 'they must think I am no good'; tense tone, avoiding discussion of counter-evidence.

manifestations: Lacks support from family and friends; mainly relies on a pet for emotional support
Avoiding socializing and workplace networking activities, difficulty building meaningful interpersonal connections
outcomes: Self-esteem and decreased sense of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'owning', expressed in language as: e.g. 'he is looking down on me', 'they want to exclude me', etc.
manifestations: Presuming in interviews and social situations that others look down on oneself and find one unprofessional
Negative interpretations of others' evaluations come first, ignoring facts and evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated self-doubt, emphasizing 'I am not good enough'
Before and after interviews, overly cares about others' possible evaluations, affecting performance and action

positive_force: Self-described as diligent and responsible, willing to do tasks well (inner work ethic and persistence)
Willing to try recording and positive self-talk (open to change)
Able to consider other possible factors in hiring decisions (has some cognitive flexibility)
Emotional connection with pets can briefly buffer stress and loneliness
negative_force: Over-caring about others' evaluations and tending toward negative interpretation (mind reading, predicting the future)
Overgeneralizing and catastrophizing cognitive patterns, weaken evidence of one's own abilities
Avoiding socializing and interviews, reducing chances of real performance and gaining opportunities
Scarce social support, lacking a network of friends and family with whom to discuss insecurity
Long-term experiences of being mocked solidified self-denial and shame

antecedent: When a job interview comes or upon entering the interview venue
Attending workplace networking events or unfamiliar social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Adolescent experiences of being mocked about height reinforced fear of others' evaluations, forming catastrophic anticipation of rejection and humiliation plus mind-reading tendencies
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible negative evaluation and rejection to protect self-esteem and lower anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Fewer job opportunities, limited social connections, interpersonal tension, further decline in self-esteem and self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: In interviews, excessive self-consciousness makes it hard to focus on presenting qualifications and abilities
antecedent: The interviewer starting to evaluate and question
Parts requiring highlighting one's experience and strengths
target_behavior.core_reason: Over-attributing others' attention to height, producing the overgeneralized belief 'no matter how one prepares it is never good enough'
target_behavior.function: Trying to reduce the psychological gap when negated through self-deprecation and defensive focus
target_behavior.consequence: On-site performance impaired, difficulty effectively presenting qualifications and strengths, increasing the likelihood of not yet being hired and deepening the negative cycle
